sections.heading: Company profile
sections.body:
TGWraps is a vehicle wrap and custom graphics company with over 30 years of experience transforming vehicles into mobile brand ambassadors using premium materials and certified installation.

Industry: Automotive Graphics & Wrapping · HQ: Rogers, MN · Size: not published · Products: Vehicle Wraps, Truck Wraps, Trailer Wraps, Fleet Graphics, Food Truck Wraps, Emergency Vehicle Wraps

sections.heading: Qualification summary
sections.body: TGWraps scores 72 of 100 (tier B) at 85% confidence. The score is carried by industry fit (24/30), application fit (25/25), event engagement (8/15) and pain-point alignment (15/15). Nothing was found for company size, so those score zero rather than being estimated.

sections.heading: Tedlar angle
sections.body: They already market on uv resistance, weatherability, lifespan, which means the durability conversation is a product discussion rather than an education. Relevant Tedlar positioning: Tedlar PVF films hold colour and gloss through years of direct UV exposure. Tedlar's proven outdoor weatherability extends graphic life in harsh climates. Tedlar overlaminates let printers underwrite longer graphic warranties.

sections.heading: Comparable accounts
sections.body: Closest known-good accounts: Avery Dennison Graphics Solutions (40% similar on wrap, graphics, vehicle, vinyl); Mactac (18% similar on vehicle, vinyl, graphics, film); Drytac (12% similar on graphics, film, vinyl, protection). Reference the comparable account by name on the call — a converter is far more persuaded by what a peer does than by a spec sheet.
